## Agents (39)

- **adversarial-reviewer** — Tier-2 paired adversarial reviewer (VAO Layer 2)
- **backend** — Backend teammate (endpoints, services, migrations, dev-API tests), the tier-2 producer
- **bug-classifier** — Triages the requirement as bug, feature, mixed, unclear (ask the user) or data-eng
- **bug-replicator** — Reproduces the reported symptom against live dev with a Playwright user-flow (frontend) or a backend script
- **closeout-agent** — Closeout double-check (CO-1...CO-3) from the working-tree diff, UPDATING stale docs rather than flagging them
- **codebase-map-reviewer** — Reviews the codebase, route and design maps against the code for missing modules, unmapped routes and stale entries
- **diagnostic-researcher** — Maps the FULL code flow from test input to failing assertion into ranked evidence-anchored hypotheses
- **doc-updater** — Documentation-currency updater -- rewrites inventory docs the run's diff made stale
- **domain-researcher** — Finds personas + objectives in docs / code plus MANDATORY outside research (industry, market, competitor)
- **editability-reviewer** — Enumerates every entity attribute a feature creates or edits, decides which a user should control
- **endpoint-tracer** — Writes ENDPOINT_TRACE_MAP.md plus the lineage-graph sidecar, reconciled against the code-path witness
- **fix-sensibility-checker** — Computes a fix's IMPACT SET, authors Playwright sensibility flows per item and runs them on dev
- **flow-executor** — Runs EVERY Playwright flow against the live target, verdict pass | fail | flaky | env-failure
- **flow-explorer** — Proposes 10-15 ADDITIONAL Playwright flows adjacent to, DIFFERENT from the literal flow
- **frontend** — Frontend teammate (UI, state, routing, Playwright user-flows), the tier-2 producer
- **integration** — Integration agent -- runs the selected tests locally then on the live dev API; frontend changes MUST get Playwright user-flows
- **integration-explorer** — Produces an integration synthesis from every CODEBASE_MAP / ROUTE_MAP plus boundary code
- **interaction-intuiter** — Intuits each interactive-by-design element's action and endpoint, with a confidence and a question per low-confidence item
- **interaction-observer** — Pass 1 of interactive-mockup-discovery -- drives an HTML mockup oracle in headless Playwright, simulates every interaction and records …
- **interaction-reviewer** — Classifies wiring of each interactive element and page a slice ships; audits Playwright tests for genuine interaction
- **master-synthesizer** — Fixer seat of the ct6-converge integration-map workflow -- merges the three explorer drafts into the canonical INTEGRATION_MAP.md
- **mcp-design-agent** — Designs output contracts (MCP-1...3) where an app embeds an LLM -- JSON Schema, FORCED structured output, validate-and-retry
- **mini-qa** — The mini lane's single QA agent -- selected tests on the real dev API plus up to 3 narrow Playwright flows on live dev
- **monitor-synthesizer** — Classifies watcher findings as flake / regression / environmental / new and writes the run's final report
- **oracle-deriver** — VAO Layer 1 -- walks a named oracle into a frozen, user-confirmed spec
- **prompt-refiner** — Grades a free-text prompt against the codebase maps on six axes, with codebase-anchored clarifying questions, never invented
- **qa-replayer** — Re-runs the B2 reproduction artifacts against live dev, verifying the symptom is gone with a code-path witness
- **reconciler** — Merges parallel teammate work on a shared boundary (interfaces, schemas, contracts), resolving file, semantic and contract conflicts
- **reference-tracer** — Closes the reference-impact set for its shard of the movement table with file:line evidence
- **route-mapper** — Statically enumerates every route, component tree and API call into the ROUTE_MAP; with design inputs (screenshots, Figma, tokens) also …
- **scaffold-agent** — Generates new domain-specific agent .md files into the plugin's agents/ from existing agents as templates
- **structure-adversary** — Refutation-only -- tries to BREAK the restructure plan, re-runs the partition check
- **structure-analyst** — Drafts a COMPLETE restructure proposal -- target tree, full file partition, per-movement rationale
- **system-architect** — Architectural deep-dives, design refinement and contract audits -- the Phase 2 architect brief plus nine audit modes
- **task-reviewer** — Independent verdict on one completed teammate task (criteria vs diff, linters, tests, stub grep)
- **test-completeness-verifier** — Verifies work has unit, integration and Playwright coverage on the real backend, not mocks, with no vacuous flows
- **test-run-watcher** — Drives the Phase M1 adapter (local / CI / production QA), runs the test source, captures per-finding JSON
- **visual-analyzer** — OBJECTIVE analysis of captures -- computed-style and pixel diffs against the DESIGN_MAP
- **visual-capture** — Runs the LIVE app, capturing screenshots and computed styles per DESIGN_MAP screen
